value.description: The label of the action. This label can be used in the UI to display the action.
The parameters for the model initialization. The parameters can be used to specify additional parameters used during the model initialization, like the meta-model, for example.

The payload for the resetModel action. This action will reset the model to the specified state. The payload can be used to specify the state to reset the model to. If no state is specified, the model will be reset to an empty state.

#708: restarts the application's evolution traces from its current model, when the agreement check refuses a freeze or a commit and the model is right as it is. A versioned-internal application freezes the version named versionName; a versioned-git application appends a marker, committed with the model.

#9: installs the model of the application version named version on a following deployment: rewrites the application's own model rows to that version's (createEntity for an added Entity, alterEntityAttribute for an added attribute, upsert and delete for the other rows), then records the version in the deployment's DeploymentState row. Refused on an authoring deployment.
The name of the Application Version to install

#9: writes the draft Migration of the application between the versions named from and to, in its modelVersion section: the structure changes between the two versions, classified, with an empty fill step per added attribute and an empty contract step per removed Entity or attribute. Refused on a following deployment, across a re-baseline of the evolution traces, when the traces disagree with the versions, and when a Migration for the two versions exists (unless replace).
The name of the version the data starts at
The name of the version the data ends at
Replace the Migration for the two versions when there is one

#9, #745: runs a Migration on a following deployment: its steps in order, each model step one model Action the designer ran, each data step a sequence of data writes. Each step is recorded in the deployment's DeploymentState row as started, then as done: a stopped migration run continues at the first step not started, and a step started and not recorded as done stops it until settleMigrationStep settles it. Refused on an authoring deployment, for a Migration already applied, when the deployment is not at the Migration's from version, when the Migration holds an unsupported change, while another Migration runs, and while a step is in doubt.
The uuid of the Migration to run, in the application's modelVersion section

#745: settles the step a stopped migration run left in doubt on a following deployment (started, not recorded as done): outcome done records it as done, and the next runMigration continues after it; outcome notRun clears it, and the next runMigration executes it again. Refused on an authoring deployment, and for a step that is not in doubt.
The uuid of the step in doubt, as runMigration names it
done: the step's writes all landed (or were completed by hand); notRun: none landed (or they were undone by hand)
#708: appends one record to the application's evolution trace, in its modelVersion section. Sent by the DomainController that ran a commit, a freeze or a re-baseline.
